metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task converts fermionic operators to full-Fock-space matrices with occupation-basis ordering and fermionic sign conventions.

task.problem_statement: Second-quantized fermionic operators in Qiskit Nature already support symbolic algebra, but users still lack a direct way to turn a FermionicOp into its matrix representation on the full fermionic Fock space. This blocks straightforward spectral checks and matrix-based downstream workflows that are already available for related operator types. FermionicOp should expose a public to_matrix conversion that produces the operator matrix in occupation-number basis and preserves the existing nearby operator behavior.
requirements: FermionicOp must provide a public to_matrix conversion over the full fermionic Fock space in occupation-number basis.
The basis ordering used by to_matrix must be the increasing bitstring order of the occupation-number basis states.
FermionicOp.to_matrix must support returning either a sparse matrix representation or a dense numpy array.
The matrix representation must correctly handle identity, number, emptiness, creation, annihilation, and multi-term operators with fermionic sign conventions.
Matrix conversion for physically relevant fermionic Hamiltonian terms must preserve the expected spectrum and particle-number structure of the resulting states.
Existing FermionicOp multi-term construction, addition, matrix multiplication, reduction, and hermiticity behavior must remain compatible.

interface.Name: FermionicOp.to_matrix
interface.Description: Returns the full-Fock-space matrix representation of the fermionic operator in occupation-number basis, optionally as a dense array.

fail_pass.summary: 1 selected selector failed with AttributeError because FermionicOp does not implement to_matrix.
